name: Obento Gogo
source:
A story about the older sister making the first move at the start of the new school term (around 1000 characters)
Note: Contains elements of incest. Please be cautious if you are uncomfortable with such themes.
translation:
讲述新学期伊始，姐姐主动迈出第一步的故事，篇幅约1000字。
注意：本作含有乱伦元素，不接受此类题材的玩家请谨慎游玩。
